root_idea.summary: The root centers on reaching or arriving at something.
root_idea.development: From physical arrival, the usage extends to attaining a limit, stage, age, purpose, or degree; causing something to reach another; conveying something to a recipient; and having sufficient means to attain an end.

senses.definition: To reach, arrive at, or attain a destination, point, term, or intended stage.
senses.usage_conditions: The construction may describe actual attainment or, with an appointed term, being near the point of completion.

senses.definition: To attain maturity, full growth, puberty, or a specified age or stage.
senses.usage_conditions: Used of reaching a developed or appointed stage, including maturity, manly vigor, working ability, or a stated age.

senses.definition: To come to or reach someone, especially of old age or another condition coming upon a person.
senses.usage_conditions: This is a recipient-oriented construction, as in old age reaching someone, rather than saying that the person reaches a place.

senses.definition: To cause to reach; to convey, deliver, or communicate something to a recipient.
senses.usage_conditions: Used both of bringing a person or thing to a destination and of delivering a message, news, greeting, or divine communication.

senses.definition: To cause a person or thing to reach a destination or an intended outcome.
senses.usage_conditions: The causative construction can describe bringing someone to a place of safety or bringing someone to a resulting condition.

senses.definition: To convey or communicate a message, statement, or information.
senses.usage_conditions: Used of completing the delivery of what one has been charged to communicate.

senses.definition: Reaching or attaining a destination, object, degree, or intended result.
senses.usage_conditions: The active participle describes something that reaches its target or reaches the limit or purpose appointed for it.

senses.definition: Fully reaching its intended force or degree; complete, conclusive, or binding.
senses.usage_conditions: Applied to an argument, wisdom, covenant, or oath that has attained its intended conclusiveness, completeness, or binding force.

senses.definition: The conveying, delivery, communication, or announcement of a message; a message or notification thus conveyed.
senses.usage_conditions: Frequently used of communicating revelation, instruction, or a warning, and may refer either to the act of communication or to its communicated content.

senses.definition: Sufficiency or an adequate exposition or means for attaining an intended end.
senses.usage_conditions: The sense concerns something that suffices or provides enough guidance or means, rather than the act of transmitting a message.

senses.definition: Eloquent, penetrating, or effective in speech or expression.
senses.usage_conditions: The expression reaches its intended meaning and is suited to its addressee or produces the intended effect.

senses.definition: The extent, limit, degree, or amount reached; a resulting sum or total.
senses.usage_conditions: The noun can denote the point or degree attained or the amount resulting from reaching or adding up quantities.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The reaching or arrival of a letter or written communication.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a document or writing arriving at its recipient.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Information coming to one's knowledge or being reported to one.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The recipient construction بَلَغَنِي commonly introduces news or information that has come to the person's knowledge.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To affect, distress, overpower, or take effect upon someone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used elliptically of harm, hardship, wine, a saying, or another influence reaching a person.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To exhaust, jade, harass, or impose hardship upon a person or beast.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A construction with an object or with an expressed hardship can mean bringing the object to the utmost of distress or fatigue.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To reach full growth or ripeness.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Said of plants and herbage attaining full growth and of trees or fruit becoming ripe.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To cause someone to reach an appointed end, term, or resulting condition.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A causative construction in which the reached destination or outcome is understood from context.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be eloquent, perspicuous, sharp, or effective in speech.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The verb describes attaining the intended meaning through suitable and forceful diction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To stretch out the hand or give the rein to a horse so that it increases its speed.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized equestrian construction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For gray hair to begin appearing on someone's head.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reported usage concerning the onset of hoariness.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To exceed ordinary or proper bounds and exert oneself to the utmost.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of extraordinary effort, energetic pursuit, thoroughness, or excess in an affair.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To bring one's utmost power, effort, or ability to an affair.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A construction describing applying the full measure of one's effort to accomplishing something.

other_classical_meanings.definition: More or most effective, efficacious, or eloquent.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used as a comparative or superlative, including of speech, praise, or eulogy whose force exceeds the ordinary.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To constrain or apply oneself until reaching a place or desired object.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The reflexive form emphasizes effort or persistence in attaining the goal.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be satisfied or content with something and attain one's desire by it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of accepting a means as sufficient for reaching what one seeks.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For disease or illness to become severe and distress someone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A construction in which the malady reaches an extreme degree in the affected person.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To reach or attain an utmost degree by gradual intensification.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of tanning taking full effect in leather and of anxiety, grief, or disease becoming extreme.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To affect or assume eloquence in speech without genuinely possessing it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The usage contrasts affected eloquence with being truly eloquent.

other_classical_meanings.definition: In an idiom, the hoped-for non-arrival of an unwelcome event or tidings.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in expressions meaning, in effect, “may it be heard but may it not reach or come upon us.”

other_classical_meanings.definition: Foolish or stupid, yet attaining one's desire; or foolish in the utmost degree.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An intensifying adjectival usage, with the first interpretation combining stupidity with successful attainment.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Extremely bad, evil, or wicked.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to a person in an emphatic expression of extreme moral badness.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A sufficiency or adequate means of subsistence; enough to enable one to attain what one seeks.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The item may denote a sufficient livelihood or anything that satisfies and enables attainment of an objective.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A calumniator, slanderer, or person who carries people's speech to others.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The meaning concerns transmitting people's words in a blameworthy or talebearing manner.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A calamity, misfortune, disaster, or extreme distress.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A fixed plural-like expression used for an affliction that has reached an extreme degree.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Great, severe, distressing, or afflictive.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied especially to a calamity or comparable circumstance of pronounced severity.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Eloquence: speech appropriate to its occasion, clear in expression, and effective in conveying its intended meaning.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term concerns the quality of speech and the speaker's ability to formulate language suited to the situation and addressee.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Slanders or calumnies.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A plural usage distinct from the technical sense of eloquence.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A boy or girl who has attained puberty, virility, ripeness, or maturity.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A classical adjectival use describing attainment of physical or legal maturity.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A good, goodly, or excellent thing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An adjectival use in which the form qualifies something as notably good or excellent.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A rope or cord joined to a well-rope so that it reaches the water.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized term for an extension or joining cord used in drawing water.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A thong wound around the curved end of a bow where the bowstring ends, to secure the string.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized archery term.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A sum of money, especially a considerable amount, or ready cash.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This financial sense is a later or specialized extension of the notion of an amount reached or totaled.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A person whose office is to chant specified words, such as the call announcing the commencement of prayer, in a mosque.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A technical religious-office usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One who is caused to reach an appointed end or term of life.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of the object of the construction بَلَغَ اللهُ بِهِ, with the intended end or term understood.

lane_unit_coverage.note: Its several reach, maturity, recipient, letter, ripening, effect, hardship, and eloquence branches are represented.

Passive usage describes being exhausted or distressed.

Usage concerning the appearance of gray hair.
Exceeding bounds and exerting the utmost effort.
Form IV causative and utmost-effort constructions.
Cross-reference and editorial qualification; no additional lexical branch.
Constrained effort to reach a place.
Being satisfied with a means and attaining one's desire.
Gradual attainment of an extreme degree.
Fixed idiom concerning unwelcome tidings or events reaching someone.
Rare adjectival usage combining foolishness and attainment or extreme foolishness.
Sufficiency or adequate means of subsistence.
Slanderer or carrier of people's speech.
Variants concerning what is communicated or those who communicate it.
Eloquence, penetration, and effectiveness in speech.
Independent sense of great or severe, especially of calamity.
Plural sense of slanders or calumnies.
Reaching or attaining and the Quran-attested binding-oath usage.
More or most effective or eloquent.
Excessive or emphatic praise is covered by the same comparative branch.
Two specialized cord usages are both represented.
Further specification of the bow-cord usage.
Extent, degree, sum, and specialized monetary amount.
Passive construction for one caused to reach an appointed end.

cautions: بَلَغَ may describe completed attainment or, with an appointed term, being on the verge of completion; the construction determines which nuance applies.
The Form II and Form IV verbs overlap in conveying or causing something to reach, but remain separate public forms because QAC identifies distinct derived forms.
